purpose: GPT-B3 + GPT-B6 closure (partial): extended joint fit with PSF FWHM + PSF depth + EBV brick-level templates added on top of the rank-resolved 8-template basis. Per-galaxy b/a + fracdev + shape_r still requires DR8 sweep download (pod-bound; v1.0.142 follow-up).
interpretation: Extending the rank-resolved 8-template fit (GEM-B2) with PSF FWHM + PSF depth + EBV (3 brick-level templates aggregated from DR8 survey-bricks) yields the 11-template fit. A_dipole = 0.257% f_CW with bootstrap σ = 0.1130% f_CW (NSIDE=8, N_boot=1000). Interpretation (i) at 1.7% remains formally excluded at z_boot = -12.77σ. The PSF/depth/EBV templates absorb additional pixel-coherent systematic structure but do not degrade the interpretation-(i) exclusion, confirming the headline conclusion is robust to brick-level depth + PSF + extinction template additions.
